confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Da Nang price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship, with wine and cocktails priced above local beer as is typical in tourist-area venues. The FX observation was read from the RBA homepage snippet rather than the F11 table itself, so it should be verified against the official table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional Vietnamese coastal and tourism-city price levels, using Nha Trang and Hoi An as the closest comparables, with Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City tourist-district prices as a cross-check.
